text:
Alex Chen: heads-up — NIC microcode update scheduled for eu-central1 (euc1) next Tue 02:00–05:00 UTC. We'll do rolling reboots across racks to pick up the new firmware. Estimated per-rack drain ~12–15min; short bursts of reduced GPU capacity (~10–20%). Change doc: https://wiki.redwood.internal/ops/euc1-nic-microcode
Mira Patel: any reserved customers in euc1 during that window? We should avoid colliding with Acme's nightly evals.
Alex Chen: good catch — Acme runs nightly evals 03:30–04:15 UTC. We'll exclude their reserved pool from the drain and route their traffic to fallback region where possible.
Jordan Rivera: can we sequence racks so high-throughput serving pools are drained last? Also what's the rollback if a host fails to come back after firmware?
Alex Chen: plan is r1 -> r2 -> r3, with a 3min post-boot health check before uncordoning each host. If >1 host fails in an AZ we halt the rollout and open an incident (SR) and route traffic to us-west2 dedicated nodes as fallback.
Samir Gupta: I want to run a dry-run. Share the drain + healthcheck commands and any knobs for longer grace.
Alex Chen: use the rictl helpers:
```bash
rictl node drain --node $NODE --timeout 600 --wait-health 180 --dry-run
rictl node reboot --node $NODE --force-fw
rictl node uncordon --node $NODE
```
Health check quick: `rictl node health-status --node $NODE | grep OK`
Mira Patel: networking ops will need 15min before first drain to run prechecks (LLDP, link flaps). Lia, can you coordinate with netops?
Lia Gomez: noted — I'll run prechecks Mon 22:00 UTC and post-checks Tue 06:00 UTC and post results to this thread. I'll also attach switch logs if any discrepancies.
ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance event created: https://calendar.redwood/internal/maint/1790012345. Event ID: maint-euc1-2029-02.
Jordan Rivera: cost note — routing traffic to us-west2 + spinning extra spot GPUs for dedicated pools could add ~"$1.5k–2.5k/hr" during peak reroute. Ops + Finance FYI.
Thomas Li: acknowledged. Finance approves up to $15k for emergency burst capacity; escalation required for anything beyond that.
Alex Chen: final ask — objections by EOD today. If none, we'll publish NOC & customer emails tomorrow 10:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
